message.content: Hey, I need to send a quick note to my client in Hamburg. Can you draft a message in German? I need to tell him the translation for the technical manual is ready for review. Keep it professional but friendly.

content.text: Sure, Oskar. Here is a draft for you: "Hallo [Name], ich habe die Übersetzung des technischen Handbuchs abgeschlossen. Sie können sich den Entwurf jetzt anschauen. Bitte geben Sie mir bis Ende der Woche Rückmeldung, falls Sie Fragen oder Anpassungswünsche haben. Viele Grüße, Oskar Lindqvist." Shall I send this to his email?

message.content: Yes, send it to his usual address. Also, while you're at it, can you check the current mortgage rate for my loan? I heard it might have changed recently.

content.text: I have checked your loan details. Your interest rate was updated on Sunday 15 March. The new rate is 3.40 percent. It was previously 3.25 percent. Would you like me to calculate how this affects your monthly payment?

message.content: Not right now, thanks. I’m just keeping track. By the way, did we renew our home insurance with Trygg Hansa yet? I feel like we might have missed a confirmation email.

content.text: According to your records, the policy with Trygg Hansa is active and the next renewal is due in November 2026. There is no pending action required at the moment. Is there anything else you need help with today?

message.content: Actually, yes. I need to plan dinner for tonight. We have chicken breasts, rice, and some frozen vegetables. Can you suggest a simple recipe? And while you're at it, add the missing ingredients to our shopping list for tomorrow.

content.text: A stir-fry would work well. You’ll need soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and a bit of oil. I’ve added soy sauce, fresh ginger, and garlic to your shopping list for tomorrow. Do you need anything else?
